source_text: For adolescents, circumcision may cause temporary discomfort or adjustment issues with masturbation after the procedure, as sexual activity including masturbation is typically advised against for 4–6 weeks during healing; some then experience a period of adaptation to exposed-glans sensation, but long-term difficulties are not well-supported by high-quality systematic reviews.
